📅 Daily Mode
1

Each day a new challenge drops — a theme like "Premier League Goals · Spanish Legends" with 11 player cards.

2

You're shown a player and their stat. The next player is revealed — tap Higher or Lower to guess.

3

Get it wrong once and you receive a yellow card warning. You can still complete the challenge.

4

Get it wrong a second time and it's a red card — game over. Come back tomorrow for a new challenge.

5

Complete without a red card and you earn a Career Cap. Build your streak to climb the status tiers.

⚡ Rush Mode
1

Choose a category — Premier League goals, international caps, club appearances and more.

2

You have 30 seconds. Answer as many higher-or-lower questions as you can.

3

Get one wrong and you lose possession — you can keep going but the perfect run bonus is gone.

4

Get two wrong and the session ends immediately.

5

Finish a perfect run with no mistakes and your score doubles. Your best scores go on the global leaderboard — weekly and all-time.

🧢 Career Caps
1

Play the daily challenge every day to earn caps. Each successful completion adds one to your tally.

2

Caps unlock status tiers from Academy Prospect all the way up to Hall of Fame.

3

Your peak caps are tracked separately — even if your streak resets, your best is always remembered.

💡 Tips

In Rush Mode a perfect run doubles your score — if you're on a clean run near the end, play it safe.

Rush categories have separate weekly and all-time leaderboards — you can top this week even if someone has a higher all-time score.

Stats are all-time career figures unless the challenge theme says otherwise.
